[EXPERIMENTAL] List policy issues for an organization

## Synopsis

[EXPERIMENTAL] List policy issues for an organization.

Lists the active policy issues for the organization, or the closed
issues when --closed is passed. Each issue represents a violation
detected by a Policy Pack during a stack update or a continuous-compliance
scan, and includes the violating resource, policy details, status, and
enforcement level.

Default output is a human-readable table; pass --output=json for the
full response as a JSON envelope.

```
pulumi policy issue list [flags]
```

## Examples

```
  # List active policy issues
  pulumi policy issue ls

  # List all closed policy issues as JSON
  pulumi policy issue ls --closed --all --output json

  # List open high and critical severity issues
  pulumi policy issue ls --severity high --severity critical --status open

  # List issues for a stack, newest first, as JSON
  pulumi policy issue ls --stack web/prod --sort observedAt:desc --output json
```
